class.name: GamePauseMenu
class.brief_description: DOD NOTE: GamePauseMenu coordinates the runtime pause lifecycle across `Game`, the active `GameBoard`, and the player's possessed `GameAgent`.
class.description: DOD NOTE: GamePauseMenu coordinates the runtime pause lifecycle across `Game`, the active `GameBoard`, and the player's possessed `GameAgent`. Following the slot-injection pattern established by `GameMenu`, UI artists can bind custom buttons, quick-switch dropdowns, and telemetry labels via `@export` properties, or allow `validate_pause_menu()` to construct a clean fallback layout automatically. Quick-switch controls operate directly on the active entity's `GameplayMode` and `GameplayStyle` cascade while respecting mid-game lock rules (`allow_mid_game_change`). Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
